_doc: ruby_maps (WP3, 2026-10-08) story objects that exist only in a Ruby build (data/story/ruby/ is read through b2tools/version.py overlay: a file name not in data/story/ is added in Ruby, never read by a Sapphire build): Magma Hideout 1F and B1F, pokeruby data/maps/MagmaHideout_1F/B1F/map.json tiles and objects (uid = pokeruby local id), as ch8b.json's Aqua Hideout objects. Scripts: src/field_scripts/ruby/0456_room_MagmaHideout_1F.s (2, 3) and 0462_room_MagmaHideout_B1F.s (3, 4); trainers are eye-contact scripts 3000 + Black 2 id (converter/gen_trainer_npcs.py moves). The item balls (B1F uids 4, 5, 7; B2F uid 5) are the room generator's (data/interiors/ruby/231.json, 234.json); B2F's objects are ruby_scenes.json's. Sprite codes 293/294 show Magma grunt art in a Ruby build (WP4's overlay).
